cn.t: Critics hail this RSC import as a dazzlingly inventive triumph, praising Tim Minchin's witty lyrics and Matthew Warchus's imaginative direction. Some find the production exhausting and the score uneven, but most celebrate its smart, unsentimental take on Dahl's tale.
